what: Dark theme storm crest at 8 m and up (2026-10-20): today's fiery-orange crest core vs dark's wave-height wash, and the 8 m+ dark warm inks (v2 ember-black, the default; ember red on the A/B lever). Model: frontend/scripts/wind-color/dark-storm-crest.mjs. Real engine: scn_wave_palette_ab.js THEMES=dark VARIANTS=d1,v2,de PAIRED=1 over serve_synthetic.py --dynamic 1 --vortex-peak 11, read by crest_by_height.py. Rebuilt on dev f6b80f724 (lead review, 2026-10-20): engine_dev_confirmation re-reads the eye view on that build. 2026-10-21: the owner rejected the dark 8 m+ inks; v2 is now electric blue (0, 0, 1): electric_blue holds its model rows and engine run. 2026-10-21 (later): cased holds the cased-orange alternative (no colour switch), with Leonardo APCA per band. SHIPPED (D-039, the owner's pick, 2026-10-21): the cased orange; electric blue and the A/B lever removed.
